Creator: SunjooAn
MigrationTest: Synthetic projects, moved/renamed folders and source images, independent receiver storage; real OBS33 Studio Mode with isolated portable profile
Checks: Immutable broadcast identity in saved projects and snapshots
Fingerprint-based source relink after folder/file renaming
Atomic on-air pointer replacement and rollback
Failed pointer replacement retains current binding
Transport integrity and path traversal rejection
Chromium local-file auto update and actual replacement pixels
Actual OBS activation replay, preview wait and update without reloading source
Limitations: Existing OBS packages require one initial switch to the managed entry.html
Moving receiver storage requires updating OBS local-file path
Changed image dimensions require checking OBS browser width/height
Fingerprint lookup needs saved fingerprints and unchanged source bytes; otherwise use manual relink
Earlier broadcast revisions remain in receiver storage
